about: GENERATED by npm run modules:generate from sdk/machines/octatrack/frame-costs-base.json and each module's evidence/frame-cost.json: never edit by hand. What each measured Octatrack module adds to the longest frame interrupt of a reading, in percent of a frame: `first` for one alone on the Part (its first track or slot there, with what waking it from rest adds), `each` for every further one, and `rest` installed on no track or slot (against the same set without it; a module that rests reads about 0, and a missing `rest` is 0). The site sends this table with every module set (MWMS v2, sdk/runtime/loader/set_package.h, as use = each, wake = first - each and rest); the base judges every module pick by the longest frame it would play, or a full stock load (mw_stock_reserve) with the Part's modules and every installed module's `rest` on top when that is more, against mw_frame_line (status.c). `stock`, the base's own figures in percent of a frame, takes the compiled ones' place: the stock reserve for a pattern whose busiest step trigs 0 to 8 tracks (`reserveBySteps`), with `trackPlay` for each further track that trigs off that step and `measuredMargin` on a pattern's own measured stock once it has played, with a margin for what a pattern cannot show (`reserveMargin`) and a floor (`reserveFloor`), the share one sample track takes, which a machine in its place gives back (`trackStock`), and the line no pick may reach (`line`). A module not listed: a machine is charged its measured meter cost or its price (12 % when it names none) a track, an effect nothing, and either 3 % more when it wakes from rest. Measure with `npm run device:price` on a unit: c(n), the longest frame's rise over 8 s with n = 1 to 4 of the module on empty tracks or slots of a medium pattern (trigs every four steps on six tracks, two of them playing samples, about 80 % with stock alone: on a busy one the guard caps the longest frame and a module reads low, and on a track that plays a sample a machine saves that render and reads low). `each` is the steepest step from the third on, max(c3 - c2, c4 - c3); `first` the least that covers every reading with it, the most of c(n) - (n - 1) * each. With one reading only, `first` and `each` are both c(1). `rest` is device:price's at-rest reading, atRest.frameMax - before.frameMax (C04, twin dce1d30e, 22 Nov 2026: FM Synth 0.1.4 20.3, Euclid 2.5, every other listed module within -2.5 to +1.7, so 0; POLY8 and the sidechain compressor not read). Prefer a reading on the newest base. A negative reading counts 0. Base-owned: a module's own folder never changes for it.

stock.measured: Owner's MKII, base 0.8 twin dce1d30e, 22 Nov 2026, Dev17 bank C, stock alone, longest frame: empty pattern 35.9 %, four tracks (two samples) 75.0 %, six (two samples) 79.4 %, eight sample tracks 98.7 % (delays awake 105.6, with LFOs and p-locks 112.8): 7.2 a sample track. Reserve 88: a medium Part with room to grow by about two sample tracks; at it an empty Part refuses no more than a medium one, and the seventh Tape Echo is refused (85 admits it, 92 refuses Amiga + Tape Echo + Mini Verb). Line 120: no render dropped from 95 to 125 % on stock-heavy Parts; module-heavy Parts dropped from about 114 % (3 to 16 in 15-30 s), none at 100-113 %. Eleven picks per session, these curves: 7 of 11 on empty and on medium, 0 renders dropped. Reserve by the busiest step of the bank (22 Nov 2026, owner): twin 7a5b0949, no modules, bank C, C05 with samples on all eight tracks, trigs added one track at a time on steps 1/5/9/13, delays at default sends, longest frame over 8 s: 37.1 with none trigging, 64.2 with one (the step frame's own work), then about 5.4 a track to 101.0 at eight (a saved Part with eight trigging but five empty slots: 89.3, so empty-slot trigs cost less; the sample figure is the safe side); margin 8, since delays awake added about 7 at eight; floor 60 so a project built on an empty pattern keeps room for its trigs. Each track that trigs but not on the busiest step adds 2.6 (twin 7a5b0949, bank C, samples on all eight: one trig on every step, T_k on k and k+8, 82.3 %; two on every step 85.1 %; frame = 37 + 24.6 with any trig + 2.7 (N - 1) + 2.6 (T - 1) fits all four within 0.3, modwerk-bd, so a pattern is judged by reserveBySteps[N] + trackPlay (T - N), N its busiest step, T its tracks that trig; the pattern that plays (and a queued one) decides, not the bank's busiest (owner, 22 Nov 2026). Margin 4 on a pattern's own measured stock (modwerk-bd, twins 28 to 31: the 15 s longest frame read 1 to 4 over the 4 s one, and margin 8 refused every first heavy machine on C03 though Amiga, SYNTIZ and FM Synth played there at 95 to 106 % with nothing dropped).
